comments.author: Sslaxx
comments.content: Why MS-PL, as opposed to MIT?

comments.author: Alex Warren
comments.content:
There's no particular reason for me to favour one over the other - from what I understand they're basically the same thing. The only real difference is that Ms-PL is more up to date in that it attempts to prevent any legal hassles involving software patents.

Is there any reason to prefer the MIT licence?

comments.author: Todd
comments.content: MIT is just more well known, I am glad you picked a non restricted license vs. GPL. If people read the license most will find it favorable, simular to Apache, Mozilla and New BSD license. I think only negative connotation comes from name of Microsoft in the license, which won't be an issue for C# or VB.Net users.
